author: wndI
content: Plan: Three commit groups for M7 completion. Group 1: erosion-local.ts (CPU stream-power for regional mesh) + worker.ts refineRegion() API + worker integration tests. Group 2: appStore regional state slice + RegionSelector.tsx (lat/lon picker, bbox drag, polygon paint) + RegionalView.tsx (2D top-down with layer toggles + hex overlay). Group 3: App.tsx integration to switch Globe/RegionalView + UI tests. Key decision: local erosion uses CPU-side simplified stream-power since the refinement pipeline already runs hydrology on CPU.
